templates.headline: Minor flooding reported in {zone}.
steps: Keep away from drains and low-lying streets in {zone}.
Watch for deeper or faster water before you set off.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Flooding is rising in {zone}.
steps: Leave low-lying parts of {zone} now and move to higher ground.
Do not walk or drive through floodwater.
Take water, phone and medicines with you.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Severe flooding in {zone}. People should evacuate now.
steps: Evacuate {zone} now to higher ground. Do not wait for the water to rise.
Go on foot. Never drive through floodwater.
Head to {shelter}, about {distance} away, if it is reachable.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Extreme life-threatening flooding in {zone}.
steps: Leave {zone} immediately and move to high ground or {shelter}.
Stay out of moving water. Do not attempt to cross flooded roads.
Stay where you are safe until the all-clear. Keep your phone charged.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Cyclone watch for {zone}. Winds may increase later.
steps: Secure loose objects outdoors and stay close to shelter.
Keep your phone charged in case the network drops.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Cyclone warning for {zone}. Expect heavy rain and strong wind.
steps: Stay indoors and away from windows.
Move to an inner room on a low floor.
Do not travel unless you must.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Severe cyclone approaching {zone}. Take shelter now.
steps: Take shelter now in a sturdy building on high ground, away from the coast.
Stay on the ground floor, away from windows.
Keep your phone charged and follow official updates.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Cyclone landfall risk for {zone}. This is life-threatening.
steps: Shelter now. Stay indoors until the official all-clear.
Stay away from the coast and from windows.
Do not go outside to check conditions.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: High temperature expected in {zone}.
steps: Drink water regularly and stay in the shade.
Rest during the hottest part of the day.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Very high heat in {zone}. Heat illness is possible.
steps: Drink water often. Avoid alcohol and heavy meals.
Carry water with you and rest in the shade.
Check on elderly people and children.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Extreme heat warning for {zone}. Heatstroke risk.
steps: Avoid going outside between midday and late afternoon.
Drink water often and stay in air-conditioned or shaded places.
Know the signs of heatstroke: confusion, collapse, very hot skin.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Dangerous heat in {zone}. Heatstroke can be fatal.
steps: Stay indoors with air conditioning or fans through the hottest hours.
Drink water regularly even if you do not feel thirsty.
Cool anyone who becomes confused or collapses straight away and call for help.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Strong winds in {zone}. Take care outdoors.
steps: Watch for falling branches and loose objects.
Secure anything light that could blow away.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Damaging winds in {zone}. Stay indoors if you can.
steps: Stay indoors and away from windows and doors.
Keep clear of trees and construction.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Severe wind warning for {zone}. Do not travel.
steps: Stay indoors and shelter away from windows.
Do not drive or walk outside.
Keep your phone charged for official updates.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Extreme winds in {zone}. Life-threatening outside.
steps: Shelter indoors on the lowest floor, away from windows.
Do not go outside until the official all-clear.
Stay clear of trees, power lines and loose structures.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Landslide risk noted in {zone} after rain.
steps: Watch for slope movement or cracks near hillsides.
Avoid walking near steep slopes after heavy rain.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Landslide risk rising in {zone}.
steps: Stay away from slopes, cuttings and rock faces.
Move away if you see ground movement, cracks or falling soil.
Do not travel through hilly areas in {zone}.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: High landslide risk in {zone}. Leave the area.
steps: Leave slopes and low ground below them now.
Move to stable, open ground away from {zone}.
Do not return until the all-clear.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: Extreme landslide risk in {zone}. Immediate danger.
steps: Leave {zone} immediately and move to open, flat ground.
Stay clear of slopes, gullies and river valleys.
Follow official instructions and do not re-enter the area.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice alert.

templates.headline: All clear for {zone}. The danger has passed.
steps: The all-clear for {zone} has been issued.
You may return, but stay alert and check for new alerts.
Keep your phone charged in case conditions change.
templates.drillNote: DRILL. This is a practice all-clear, not a real one.

drill.bannerLong: DRILL — practice alert, not a real emergency
drill.disclaimer: This alert is a drill issued for training and testing. Do not act on it as if it were a real emergency.
